# Plugin

A plugin hosted by Loom: what its poll answers, how an item is classified and projected onto the actions and data sources a governed turn may use, what the turn ends with, the line the host records for each handled item and the state it keeps between polls. A turn proposes a reply or declines; it sends nothing.

`loom.plugin` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `Classification`

`loom.plugin.Classification` is a record of three fields:

- `intent` — `loom.plugin.Intent`
- `hints` — `List<String>`
- `confidence` — `Decimal`

### `Cursor`

`loom.plugin.Cursor` is a record of two fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `value` — `String`

### `InboundItem`

`loom.plugin.InboundItem` is a record of four fields:

- `id` — `loom.plugin.ItemId`
- `revision` — `String`
- `text` — `String`
- `details` — `Json`

### `Intent`

`loom.plugin.Intent` is one of `Ask`, `Request`, `Task` and `Find`.

### `ItemFailures`

`loom.plugin.ItemFailures` is a record of three fields:

- `item` — `loom.plugin.InboundItem`
- `failures` — `Integer`
- `last_failure` — `String`

### `ItemId`

`loom.plugin.ItemId` wraps `String` and is not interchangeable with one: the whole value of naming it separately is the crossings the model then refuses.

### `Objective`

`loom.plugin.Objective` is a record of two fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `weight` — `Decimal`

### `PluginConfig`

`loom.plugin.PluginConfig` is a record of seven fields:

- `connectors` — `loom.datasource.ConnectorsCliConfig`
- `sources` — `List<loom.datasource.DataSource>`
- `objectives` — `List<loom.plugin.Objective>`
- `classify_threshold` — `Optional<Decimal>`, which may be absent
- `poll_interval_seconds` — `Integer`
- `workspace_roots` — `List<String>`
- `checkouts` — `List<String>`

### `PluginState`

`loom.plugin.PluginState` is a record of three fields:

- `cursors` — `List<loom.plugin.Cursor>`
- `handled` — `List<loom.plugin.ItemId>`
- `failing` — `List<loom.plugin.ItemFailures>`

### `Poll`

`loom.plugin.Poll` is a record of two fields:

- `items` — `List<loom.plugin.InboundItem>`
- `cursors` — `List<loom.plugin.Cursor>`

### `Projection`

`loom.plugin.Projection` is a record of two fields:

- `actions` — `List<String>`
- `sources` — `List<loom.datasource.SourceName>`

### `Proposal`

`loom.plugin.Proposal` is a record of two fields:

- `item` — `loom.plugin.ItemId`
- `text` — `String`

### `ProposedCase`

`loom.plugin.ProposedCase` is a record of three fields:

- `protocol` — `String`
- `confidence` — `Decimal`
- `reasons` — `List<String>`

### `RecordLine`

`loom.plugin.RecordLine` is a record of eight fields:

- `item` — `loom.plugin.ItemId`
- `intent` — `Optional<loom.plugin.Intent>`, which may be absent
- `confidence` — `Optional<Decimal>`, which may be absent
- `outcome` — `loom.plugin.RecordOutcome`
- `reads` — `List<loom.plugin.SourceRead>`
- `proposal` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `proposed_case` — `Optional<loom.plugin.ProposedCase>`, which may be absent
- `detail` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `RecordOutcome`

`loom.plugin.RecordOutcome` is one of `Proposed`, `Declined`, `ProposedCase`, `Unclassified` and `Stopped`.

### `SourceRead`

`loom.plugin.SourceRead` is a record of two fields:

- `source` — `loom.datasource.SourceName`
- `kind` — `loom.datasource.ReadKind`

### `TurnResult`

`loom.plugin.TurnResult` is a record of five fields:

- `outcome` — `loom.plugin.RecordOutcome`
- `reads` — `List<loom.plugin.SourceRead>`
- `proposal` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `proposed_case` — `Optional<loom.plugin.ProposedCase>`, which may be absent
- `detail` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

Seven of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `loom.plugin.Classification`, `loom.plugin.PluginState`, `loom.plugin.Poll`, `loom.plugin.Projection`, `loom.plugin.Proposal`, `loom.plugin.RecordLine` and `loom.plugin.TurnResult`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
